title: 第19章 一人之下的一人第20章 空间天赋
slug: 末世我的女人有亿点强
lines: 林羽嘴都吃麻了，不到十分钟的时间，终於把所有属性果实都吞噬了。
崭新的属性面板，让他的自信心高度膨胀。
【代号：魔术师】
【等级：0阶3级0】
【天赋：s级烈焰掌控者：进化中86】
【火焰解锁形态：烈焰，龙之炎（解锁中86）】
末世第5天。
在林羽的蝴蝶效应下，整个世界，整个华夏，进化进程都比前世快速了很多。
在前世，第6天才有人进化到5级，引发规则降临，这一世足足提前了4天。
同时，林羽在交易市场的行为，也引起了整个华夏进化者的关注与跟风。
在华夏庞大的人口基数下，就算只有极少数果实向一部分人聚拢，也能造就出一大批强者了。
“真期待世界排行榜开启的那一刻啊！”
“不知道外国人看到榜上全是华夏人的时候，表情有多精彩。”
“嘿嘿～”
林羽腹黑一笑，有些期待起来。
傍晚，林羽几人在一个珠宝店里面休息。
一边清点收获，一边吃东西补充体力。
今天的收获比昨天稍微多了一点，林羽直接分给了刘宇两人250颗，陈静儿300颗，自己留了1922颗。
“今天应该是最後的机会了，你们还是优先换果实，过了今天，以後可能都换不到了。”
林羽对着三人说道。
“老大，你的意思是，那些有果实的人都准备留着自己吃吗？”
“应该是愿意换的人，大部分都会在今天全部换出去，过了今天，应该没有多少了。”陈静儿挺聪明。
“没错，果实的作用和晶核的效果，现在所有人都知道了，前天昨天供不应求主要还是因为晶核数量不多，到了今天就不一样了。”
“是的，而且过了最初的恐惧之後，也会有一部分人尝试着去杀丧尸，如果成功，他们必然不会再交换果实。”
“所以，今天是最後的机会！”
说到这里，林羽直接点开交易市场。
现在绿色果实的价格，已经涨到了10颗晶核，黄色的涨到了38颗，比昨天翻了一倍。
林羽没有犹豫，直接挂单绿色10换1，黄色40换1。
“你们都挂好了吧！”林羽看着三人问道。
content_en:
Lin Yu's mouth was numb, and in less than ten minutes, he finally swallowed all the attribute fruits.
The brand new attribute panel made his self-confidence highly inflated.
[Codename: Magician]
[Level: Level 0, Level 3, Level 0]
[Magic power: 18500]
【Power: 249】
[Physique: 136]
【Speed: 142】
【Spirit: 185】
[Talent: S-level Flame Controller: Evolving 86]
[Unlocked form of flame: Raging Flame, Dragon Flame (unlocking 86)]
…
The fifth day of the apocalypse.
Under Lin Yu's butterfly effect, the evolution of the entire world and China was much faster than in the previous life.
In the previous life, it was only on the 6th day that someone evolved to level 5, triggering the rules to come. In this life, it was a full 4 days early.
At the same time, Lin Yu's behavior in the trading market also attracted the attention and follow suit of the entire Chinese Evolvers.
With China's huge population base, even if only a few fruits are gathered to some people, a large number of strong people can be created.
“I’m really looking forward to the moment when the world rankings start!”
"I don't know how wonderful foreigners' expressions are when they see that all the Chinese people on the list are Chinese."
"Hehe~"
Lin Yu smiled darkly, looking forward to it.
In the evening, Lin Yu and others rested in a jewelry store.
While counting the harvest, I ate to replenish my strength.
Today's harvest was slightly more than yesterday. Lin Yu directly gave 250 pills to Liu Yu and Chen Jinger, 300 pills, and kept 1,922 pills for himself.
"Today should be the last chance. You should give priority to exchanging fruits. After today, you may not be able to exchange them in the future."
Lin Yu said to the three of them.
"Boss, do you mean that those who have the fruit are going to keep it for themselves?"
"Most of those who are willing to change will be replaced today. After today, there won't be many left." Chen Jing'er is quite smart.
"Yes, everyone now knows the role of the fruit and the effect of the crystal core. The main reason why the supply exceeded demand the day before yesterday was because there were not many crystal cores. It is different today."
"Yes, and after the initial fear is over, some people will try to kill zombies. If they succeed, they will definitely not exchange fruits again."
"So, today is the last chance!"
Having said this, Lin Yu directly clicked on the trading market.
Now the price of green fruits has increased to 10 cores, and the price of yellow fruits has increased to 38 cores, which is doubled from yesterday.
Lin Yu did not hesitate and directly placed the green order for 10 for 1 and the yellow order for 40 for 1.
"Are you all ready?" Lin Yu asked, looking at the three of them.
